chunks: Another of His signs is that the heavens and the earth stay in position by His command; and then when He will call you once you will come out of the earth.
ai.seo_question: What are the signs of God's power regarding the stability of the universe and human resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm the bodily resurrection (al-Ba'th al-Jasadi), linking the cosmic order (Qiyam al-Sama' wa al-Ard) with the individual's emergence from the grave. The phrase 'from the earth' underscores the physical reality of the resurrection, a key tenet distinguishing Shia theology from purely spiritual interpretations of the afterlife.
